findings.text: The `resources` table is a hand-kept list of the SQL files that some fixtures read while they compile, and nothing says why it exists or that it must change when a fixture adds a `sql_file` or `sql_module` path; the import scan cannot find these files, so a missed entry fails only when the suite runs on Nix. Fix: add a comment above `resources` that says the import scan cannot see SQL files read by `sql_file`/`sql_module`, and that each new SQL path of a fixture needs an entry here.

The docstring of `test_surface_fixture_changes_only_consuming_suites` names the suites but not the code of this repository that it checks. Fix: say that it checks the fixture closure of `build-support/surface-fixtures.nix` and the `surfaceSuite` inputs in `build-support/tests.nix`, using `tests/surface_fixture_roots.json`.

The docstring of `file_probe` does not say why it reads the fixture at call time and not at import time: suites whose restricted fixture tree has no `SqlFileProbe.lean` still import this module. Fix: add that reason to the docstring.
